worldcombat.skill.screech.summary: Scream an earsplitting shriek that pushes out from your mouth as a thin front sweeping straight down a narrow corridor. The front strips one layer of Defence from each enemy it first passes, ignores cover, never stacks on the same target; a sharper shriek cuts deeper while a drawn-out one reaches further and rings longer.
worldcombat.skill.screech.use.0: Strip the Defence of enemies charging at you in a line, one after another
worldcombat.skill.screech.use.1: Press physical threats through a low wall
worldcombat.skill.screech.use.2: Soften a whole rank coming through a doorway
worldcombat.skill.screech.description.0: Each enemy the front passes loses %1$s stages of Defence and is left with about %2$s of ringing, once per target; the ringing itself changes neither stats nor actions, and the Defence drop does not come back when the ringing ends - it stays as a normal stat-stage change.
worldcombat.skill.screech.description.1: The wave reaches %1$s blocks straight ahead and %2$s blocks to each side, and the front takes about %3$s to sweep the whole way; cover does not block it, so nearby enemies are caught first and distant ones a moment later.
worldcombat.skill.screech.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.screech.preference.shr: Off (drawn cry): a wider, longer corridor that rings longer at the base drop. On (piercing shriek): the corridor narrows to about 60% and the wave shortens by 20%, but Defence drops one stage further and the cooldown is slightly shorter. Depth against duration.
Only consider the shriek when a threat is within this distance; larger commits earlier and risks hitting nothing.
Only prefer the shriek when at least this many enemies stand in the corridor; set 1 to shriek on sight.
On: when the enemies in the corridor already have ringing ears, this shriek drops in priority so the chance goes to an unstripped direction. Off: keep shrieking as usual.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to deliver the shriek.
